topic: jump start a car with a dead battery
core_question: How do you jump start a car that won't start because the battery is dead? (secondary: How can I get through airport security more quickly?)
answer_summary: Attach jumper cables red-to-positive on both batteries, black-to-negative on the good battery, then the last black clamp to an unpainted metal ground on the dead car (not its negative terminal); start the working car, let it run a few minutes, then start the dead car.; after the topic shift: Wear slip-on shoes and minimal metal, place laptops and liquids in an easily accessible spot to pull out at the bin, and have your boarding pass and ID ready before reaching the checkpoint; consider enrolling in TSA PreCheck/Global Entry.
